verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an integrations catalog under /integrations/overview. It has step-by-step pages for ticketing (Jira, ClickUp), identity/directory (JumpCloud), and FreeAgent, which is used to check whether users with access have offboarded. It also claims it integrates with your existing cloud stack and offers integration monitoring. However, the evidence shows only a few categories concretely, and nothing addresses scopes or permissions. missing for 10: evidence of cloud-provider integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure), code-hosting integrations, MDM integrations, documented read-only permission scopes, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting a real stack.
